UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Stores user account information. Does NOT include authentication secrets (passwords). Relies on external auth system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support user authentication and the MCQ quiz application. It emphasizes authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. The primary collection is `users`, which stores user account information. The `UserAccount` entity is stored under `users/{userId}`. This structure facilitates simple ownership-based security rules. To support the quiz functionality the data will be uploaded as JSON to the client and used there, this structure only implements data related to the user's account
